summaryA.html:
Your Coverage Snapshot

Hi Jordan, here's a friendly look at your Portal Live Mutual Insurance Company homeowners policy (PLB-HO-000123) for 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500. This policy runs from 07/01/2026 to 07/01/2027.

What you're covered for

Dwelling (Coverage A) $300,000 limit

This helps pay to repair or rebuild the physical structure of your home if it's damaged by a covered event. Your deductible is $1,000, which is the amount you'd pay first before this coverage kicks in.

Personal Property (Coverage C) $150,000 limit

This helps cover your belongings — things like furniture, clothing, and electronics — if they're damaged, destroyed, or stolen. Your deductible is $1,000.

Personal Liability (Coverage E) $300,000 limit

This helps protect you financially if someone is injured or their property is damaged, and you're found responsible. No deductible applies to this coverage.

Water Backup and Sump Discharge Endorsement PLB 04 61 07 26

This adds protection for damage caused by water backing up through drains or sump pumps — something a standard policy often doesn't include.

In your area

We checked local hazard data sources for your address (1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500), but no specific risk details were available to share right now. As always, general homeowner precautions are a good idea.

Worth considering

Based on what's in your policy today, here are a couple of coverages from our catalog you don't currently have that could be worth a look:

  • Flood Endorsement — Adds flood protection for your dwelling and contents. Standard homeowners policies typically don't include flood damage, so this can fill an important gap. PLB.COV.FLD PLB 04 75 07 26
  • Earthquake Endorsement — Adds protection specifically for earthquake damage, which isn't part of your current coverage. PLB.COV.EQ PLB 04 54 07 26

These are optional additions to consider — reach out anytime to talk through whether they make sense for your home.

Your Coverage Summary

Hi Casey, here's a plain-language look at your homeowners policy (PLB-HO-000666) for 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500.

What you're covered for

Dwelling Coverage (Coverage A)

This helps pay to repair or rebuild the physical structure of your home if it's damaged by a covered event.

  • Limit: $200,000
  • Deductible: $2,500

In your area

We checked hazard data sources for your address, but no specific risk facts were available to share right now.

Worth considering

Based on your policy, here are some coverages your policy doesn't currently include. These are optional additions you could ask your agent about — they're not automatically part of your plan today.

  • Water Backup and Sump Discharge — Helps cover damage if water backs up through drains or sump pumps, which standard dwelling coverage often doesn't include. PLB.COV.WB PLB 04 61 07 26
  • Flood Endorsement — Adds protection for flood damage to your home and belongings. Standard homeowners policies typically don't cover flooding, so this fills that gap. PLB.COV.FLD PLB 04 75 07 26
  • Earthquake Endorsement — Adds protection for damage caused by earthquakes, which isn't included in your current dwelling coverage. PLB.COV.EQ PLB 04 54 07 26

Chat with your agent to see which of these might be a good fit for your home.
